shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every evening.
My favorite holiday is Thanksgiving with family.
On weekends, I like to explore new parks.
I often cook dinner and try new recipes.
Traveling to new countries is always exciting for me.
Listening to music helps me relax after a busy day.
I enjoy volunteering and helping my local community.
Attending live music events brings me so much joy each year.
I love learning about different cultures through their food and traditions.
Finding time for hobbies is essential for maintaining a balanced life.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you had recently?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling to that destination?
Q3: How do you think travel impacts a person's perspective on life?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip abroad?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eco-friendly behaviors.
questions: Q1: What eco-friendly practices do you follow in your daily life?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties in adopting these practices?
Q3: Why do you believe it is important to live sustainably?
Q4: What suggestions do you have for someone looking to become more environmentally friendly?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about learning new skills.
questions: Q1: What new skill have you recently learned, and what motivated you?
Q2: What obstacles did you face while trying to master this skill?
Q3: How do you think learning new skills can benefit personal growth?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone who wants to learn a new skill effectively?
